phase: baseline chatbot evaluation of the validated gold set
endpoint: POST http://localhost:8000/chat (real production SSE pipeline, app.main)
eligible_rule: gold status GOLD_VERIFIED and judgement in {GOLD_CONFIRMED, GOLD_NEEDS_CORRECTION}
scope_note: 86 questions, not 87: Q072 was reclassified GOLD_AMBIGUOUS by the judgement pass and is excluded by the stated rule (64 CONFIRMED + 22 NEEDS_CORRECTION = 86)
routing_note: graph routing precision/recall are not measurable at this configuration: the router was attempted for every question but returned zero usable rows (3 timed_out then 83 circuit_open in an independent replay), so there are no positive predictions to score. Intent routing: 78 qa, 7 structured, 1 chitchat; 1 clear misroute (Q079 -> chitchat)

citation_validity.citation_note: no fabricated citations were found: every emitted citation resolved to a real corpus document. Q111 is the one case where the cited document does not support the specific locational claim made

graph.note: the graph never contributed to an answer. In an independent replay of the production router the first three attempts exceeded the 3.0s budget and the circuit breaker then short-circuited the remaining 83
